{{Top|leg}}
The '''Great Dance''' was a belief shared by many [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]] that they would dance forever in the bright eternal afterlife. In [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]], [[Oola/Legends|Oola]] thought of the Great Dance where she danced in a bright clean eternity. For many Twi'leks the afterlife was where they become connected to the Great Dance for all eternity.<ref name="Idol Intentions">''{{StoryCite|story=A Time to Mourn, a Time to Dance: Oola's Tale|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}''</ref>
